basic_details.job_title: IISER TVM Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The School of Mathematics at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram (IISER TVM), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is filling one Research Associate (RA) post on an ANRF-funded project, "Toward's Eick's Conjecture, Power structure in $p$-groups, and an analogue of Baer’s theorem for profinite groups". The post is on contract for 1 year, extendable depending on performance, with a fellowship of Rs.58,000/- + HRA. Interested candidates must email a detailed CV to Prof. Viji Z Thomas at [email protected] by 29 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Email the CV to Prof. Viji Z Thomas, School of Mathematics, IISER TVM, at [email protected].
Send it on or before 29 November 2026.
Watch your email: only selected candidates will be intimated via email.
Documents named in the notice: a detailed CV. The notice prints no email subject line and no application form.
important_instructions: The post is on contract basis, not a regular appointment. Only selected candidates will be intimated via email.

content_sections.heading: About IISER TVM
content_sections.text: The notice describes IISER Thiruvananthapuram as one of the premier science education and research institutes established by the Government of India in 2008, to impart high-quality education integrated with outstanding research in modern science. It invites applications for this position on contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable qualification: PhD in group theory/profinite groups. Age: minimum 24. The notice prints no maximum age limit, no cut-off date for age and no relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail prescribed by the funding agency.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate posts are vacant at IISER TVM?
faq.answer: The notice lists one Research Associate post on the ANRF-funded project in the School of Mathematics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IISER TVM Research Associate?
faq.answer: The last date is 29 November 2026. The notice was published on 12 November 2026.

faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is as prescribed by the funding agency, and the notice lists PhD under Experience Required. A PhD in group theory/profinite groups is desirable.

faq.answer: The notice prints a minimum age of 24. It gives no maximum age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the Research Associate?
